name: ArchiveMaster – Auto Archive and Export Old Orders for WooCommerce
author: WPPOOL

sections.description:
Homepage | Documentation | Tutorials | Live Demo

Optimize your WooCommerce store and store old data in a local or any remote database. With ArchiveMaster, easily archive old orders, export order data, and streamline database performance. Managing order history is no longer a hassle!

Let’s grow, connect, and thrive together!

  • 🤝 Join Our Facebook Community
  • 🌐 Follow Us on X (Twitter)
  • 🎥 Subscribe on YouTube
  • 👍 Like Our Facebook Page

Why Do You Need Archive Master?

If your WooCommerce store feels slow, old orders may be part of the reason. Historical orders take up a lot of space in your database over time, consuming valuable storage and impacting performance. Each time WooCommerce runs its functions, it also processes these older, less-relevant records, increasing query load and slowing down your site.

Archive Master takes care of the rest, ensuring that only active, necessary data remains in your primary database. 🚀

Upgrade to smarter data management. It maintains a smart, high-performance WooCommerce store by efficiently offloading old data. Keep your site fast, your store efficient, and your customers satisfied.

Previous order data takes up a lot of space in your database. And every time WooCommerce’s functionalities are loading, the order queries also load, making your site’s performance slower.

✨ Try Live Demo | ⚡ Get the Premium Version | 🤝 Join Our Facebook Community

Archive Master Plugin Helps You Achieve:

  • Optimized Database Performance: Archiving previous orders keeps your WooCommerce database optimized, improving store speed and user experience.
  • Declutter Database: Archiving old orders removes unnecessary data from your active database, keeping it clean and organized for better query performance and faster operations.
  • Bloat-Free Database: Moving historical orders to separate storage prevents database bloat, ensuring your WooCommerce store maintains optimal size and runs efficiently.
  • Store Old Data Securely: Move your old data into your local storage without affecting site performance or to a remote database and access them anytime you want without ever needing to worry about data loss.
  • Efficient Data Management: Move outdated orders to a separate database in your local storage, or to a remote database, making organizing and accessing essential data easier.
  • Improved Store Speed: A lighter database can help speed up WooCommerce, including the admin and Orders page, for a faster, more responsive experience.
  • Reduced Storage Costs: Free up space by archiving old orders, lowering storage expenses, and streamlining database maintenance.
  • Easily Configurable Settings: Set custom time frames for order archiving and manage storage locations with ease.
  • Export or Download WooCommerce Orders: Effortlessly export your orders into widely used formats such as CSV, JSON, XML, etc. Choose your preferred format and download order details in just a few clicks.

✨ Try Live Demo | ⚡ Get the Premium Version | 🤝 Join Our Facebook Community

🔝 Archive Master Free Features

  • 🗃️ Local Database Archive: Archive WooCommerce orders from any chosen date range (e.g., 7 days, 15 days, 1 month, etc). Orders will be securely transferred to your website’s local storage.

  • 🛢️ Remote Database Archive: Archive WooCommerce orders in your preferred database. Select your Amazon RDS database and choose a date range (e.g., 7 days, 15 days, 1 month, etc), and orders will be securely archived to your database.

  • 🎯 One-Click Order Archiving with Visual Insights:
    Effortlessly monitor past orders with a real-time pie chart and a convenient one-click archiving feature. Visualize your previous orders at a glance and archive them seamlessly with just a single click.

  • 🔎 Search Archived Orders: Search the archived orders from the WooCommerce orders page. The orders will be displayed with an “Archived” order status.

  • 🏷️ Search Archived Orders by Metadata: Archived orders can be searched by custom metadata.

  • 🔙 Unarchive Orders: Need to access archived order data? With just a few clicks, you can restore archived WooCommerce orders in bulk from your local or connected database anytime you need them.

  • ⏭️ Skip Archiving Active Subscription/Membership Orders:
    Archiving subscription or membership orders used to disrupt renewal payments. You can skip archiving active subscription/membership orders to ensure renewals keep working seamlessly. Archive Master can detect orders from the plugins listed below and prevent them from being archived.
    Supported plugins:
    🡪 WooCommerce Subscriptions
    🡪 WooCommerce Memberships
    🡪 YITH WooCommerce Subscriptions
    🡪 Subscriptions for WooCommerce
    🡪 Memberships for WooCommerce

  • 📋 Allow Customers to View Archived Orders: Give customers the ability to view their archived order history from their My Account page. Admins can easily toggle this visibility on or off through the settings.

  • 🎯 Archive by Specific Order Status: Choose specifically which orders you want to archive by selecting specific order statuses. For example, archive only “Completed” orders while keeping others untouched.

  • 🧾 Archive Orders from Order Page: Users can easily archive WooCommerce orders directly from the Order Details page.

  • 📚 Bulk Archive Orders from Order List Page: Select multiple orders from your WooCommerce Orders page and archive them instantly using the Bulk Actions dropdown.

  • 📅 Filter Archived Orders by Date, Day & Status: Quickly view what you need by filtering archived orders based on date, day, or order status. Only matching archived orders will be displayed, keeping things organized and accessible.

  • 🗑️ Permanently Delete Archived Orders: You can now permanently delete your archived orders. NB: Once deleted, they’re gone for good and cannot be restored.

  • 📦 Manage Old Orders: View and manage archived orders anytime from WooCommerce, with easy one-click restoration to keep your store organized and efficient!

  • 🛠️ Smart Order ID Conflict Handling: When restoring archived orders, the system automatically detects any ID conflicts with existing orders. You’ll get a prompt with options to assign a new ID to the archived order or skip it, ensuring a smooth and error-free unarchiving process.

  • 📥 Export WooCommerce Orders: Export orders in CSV, JSON, and XML for easy backup. Simply go to the plugin’s download option to save all or selected orders!

  • 💾 Export Archived Orders: Easily back up your archived orders in JSON or XML format. Just navigate to the Archived Orders section in the plugin and click “Export Orders” to download your data in seconds.

  • 📜 Activity Logs: Keep a clear record of what happens in your store’s archive. ArchiveMaster logs key actions, like archived orders and order restorations, along with the user, date, and time. Remove entries you no longer need one at a time, or clear a full page of logs at once.

  • 🌍 Translation Ready: Archive Master is fully translatable! We’ve included a .pot file, which means you can translate the plugin into your preferred language using popular translation plugins like Loco Translate or WPML.

✨ Try Live Demo | ⚡ Get the Premium Version | 🤝 Join Our Facebook Community

👑 ArchiveMaster Pro Features

  • ❇️ Archive to Google Drive: Connect your Google account to archive orders directly to the Drive and easily unarchive them anytime.

  • 🗄️ Archive to Custom MySQL Database: You can configure a custom MySQL server to store archived order data. You have the flexibility to connect to the same database or use any external MySQL database. Giving you full control over where you want to archive your data.

  • 🔄 Auto-Archive Old Orders: Set automated schedules for archiving historical orders with the plugin’s auto-archive option, keeping your WooCommerce database clean and optimized.

  • ⚡️ No Restriction on Order Range: You can archive any old orders without any restrictions!

  • 📊 Analytics for Archived Orders: Enable archived orders in WooCommerce Analytics to generate complete and accurate reports whenever needed.

  • 🌪️ Advanced Order Filtering: Archive orders by product category. You can archive your orders by selecting ‘product category’ and archiving specific orders. More filtering options are coming soon.

  • 📇 Archive Custom Metadata: Archive custom metadata stored by other plugins along with your orders so no critical data is lost. You can archive selected fields, all detected metadata, or automatically archive current and future fields. With built-in exclude lists for automatic modes, you get total control while ensuring all relevant custom data is safely stored.

  • 📆 Custom Date Selection for Archiving Orders: You can select a custom date, and orders up to that date will be archived to the chosen database.

  • 🎯 Archive by Custom Order Status: You can select and archive orders based on your own custom order statuses, giving you complete flexibility over your order archiving process.

  • 💾 Export Archived Orders in CSV: Navigate to the Archived Orders section and click “Export Orders” to export and download in CSV format.

  • 🧹 Delete All Activity Logs: Clear your entire Activity Log history in one go, even with hundreds or thousands of entries. Follow the progress as ArchiveMaster works through them, and stop the process anytime. NB: Deleted logs cannot be restored, so review your log history first.

⏰ ArchiveMaster Upcoming Features

  • 🔜 Expanded Archive Database Support (Upcoming): Archive your previous orders and data to more cloud-based storage options, One Drive, Dropbox, Amazon S3, Backblaze, Hetzner, A2 Hosting, and more. Archive old orders and data to remote databases, including Google Cloud SQL, Microsoft Azure, Digital Ocean, and more.

  • 🗄️ Content Archiving (Upcoming): Easily archive WordPress Media, WooCommerce Products, Posts, and Custom Post Types to keep your site organized and optimized. Suitable for managing large content libraries and enhancing site performance.

✨ Try Live Demo | ⚡ Get the Premium Version | 🤝 Join Our Facebook Community

🔥 More Awesome Plugins

If you like ArchiveMaster, then consider checking out our other projects:

  • 🛒 FlexOrder – Order Sync with Google Sheet for WooCommerce: Manage orders from Google Sheets. WooCommerce order sync, e-commerce order management, and sales order management with Google Sheets. Try Flex Order now!

  • 🔄 FlexStock – Stock Sync with Google Sheet for WooCommerce: Auto-sync WooCommerce products from Google Sheets. Flex Stock is an easy, powerful, and simple inventory management system to handle your WooCommerce products.

  • 🎁 EchoRewards: With Echo Reward, you can refer a friend for WooCommerce to launch your customer referral program. Echo Rewards Referral Plugin is a WooCommerce referral plugin to boost your sales. Generate coupons, reward customers, and launch the ideal refer-a-friend program for your store.

  • 🌓 WP Dark Mode: Use WP Dark Mode plugin to create a stunning dark version for your WordPress website. WP Dark Mode works automatically without going into any complicated settings.

  • 💬 FormyChat: Connect Form to Chat Apps with Contact Form 7, WPForms, Gravity Form | Welcome Popup & Multi-agent Live Chat.

Privacy Policy

Archive Master uses Appsero SDK to collect some telemetry data upon user’s confirmation. This helps us to troubleshoot problems faster & make product improvements.

Appsero SDK is included to track opt-in usage data and process deactivation feedback. See the “External services” section above for details on what is sent and when. No marketing or newsletter subscription is performed.

Integrating Appsero SDK DOES NOT IMMEDIATELY start gathering data, without confirmation from users in any case.

Learn more about how Appsero collects and uses this data.

External services

Amazon RDS / Remote MySQL

When an administrator supplies database credentials in Settings, ArchiveMaster connects to the specified MySQL server to store archived orders. No data is sent until credentials are saved. No third-party service is involved; the connection goes directly to the server you configure.

Appsero — Usage Tracking

After explicit opt-in consent, the Appsero SDK sends site environment details (PHP/MySQL/WP versions, active plugin count, admin email, site URL) to api.appsero.com once per week. Declining tracking sends zero data. You can revoke consent at any time.
Service: Appsero
Terms of Service: https://appsero.com/terms-conditions/
Privacy Policy: https://appsero.com/privacy-policy/

Appsero — Deactivation Feedback

When you deactivate the plugin and submit the optional feedback form, the site URL, plugin version, and your selected reason are sent to api.appsero.com. Skipping the form sends no data.
Service: Appsero
Terms of Service: https://appsero.com/terms-conditions/
Privacy Policy: https://appsero.com/privacy-policy/

Appsero — IP Address Lookup

When usage tracking is active, the Appsero SDK retrieves the server’s public IP address from icanhazip.com (operated by Cloudflare). Only the server IP is sent; no user-identifiable data is transmitted.
Service: icanhazip.com
Privacy Policy: https://www.cloudflare.com/privacypolicy/

YouTube — Help Videos

Settings pages embed help videos from youtube-nocookie.com (privacy-enhanced mode). No request is made until the user clicks Play. Data is handled by Google/YouTube.
Service: YouTube
Terms of Service: https://www.youtube.com/t/terms
Privacy Policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy

Google Drive — Cloud Backup (Pro add-on)

When the Pro add-on is active and the administrator authorizes Google Drive, OAuth tokens are exchanged via auth.archivemaster.pro. Archived database files are uploaded to Google Drive. No data is sent without explicit authorization.
Service: Google Drive API
Terms of Service: https://developers.google.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy

ArchiveMaster Auth Proxy — Google Drive OAuth (Pro add-on)

OAuth authentication for Google Drive is routed through auth.archivemaster.pro, which acts as a proxy to exchange authorization codes for access tokens. Only OAuth tokens and the administrator email are transmitted during the authorization flow. No data is stored on the proxy beyond token exchange.
Service: auth.archivemaster.pro
Terms of Service: https://archivemaster.pro/terms-of-service/
Privacy Policy: https://archivemaster.pro/privacy-policy/

WPPOOL — Cross-Promotion Links

Admin-only promotional banners may contain links through go.wppool.dev and lnk.wppool.dev redirect domains. These are standard URL redirects triggered only by administrator clicks. No data is collected automatically.
Service: WPPOOL
Terms of Service: https://developer.wppool.dev/terms-and-conditions/
Privacy Policy: https://developer.wppool.dev/privacy-policy/

Gravatar — Activity Log Avatars

The Activity Logs page displays user profile pictures via WordPress get_avatar_url(), which generates URLs pointing to gravatar.com. The browser requests these images directly from Gravatar, transmitting a hash of the user email address. No additional data is sent by the plugin.
Service: Gravatar
Terms of Service: https://automattic.com/tos/
Privacy Policy: https://automattic.com/privacy/

Privacy

ArchiveMaster stores archived order data in the storage selected by the administrator. It does not send usage data without consent. Administrators can decline or revoke Appsero tracking. Database credentials are stored encrypted where supported and passwords are never exposed to browser scripts.

Build Instructions

Install Node.js and Composer, run npm ci followed by npm run build, then run composer install --no-dev --optimize-autoloader. The distributable plugin includes src, package configuration, compiled build assets, and the optimized Composer autoloader.

Third-party library: assets/js/sizzle.min.js is a WPPOOL toast / notification helper (named after its selector engine, not the Sizzle CSS selector library bundled with jQuery). It is enqueued only on this plugin’s screens.
sections.installation:
1. Navigate to WordPress Dashboard > Plugins > Add New. Search for “ArchiveMaster” and activate the plugin.
  2. Access the plugin from the left sidebar of the WordPress dashboard.
  3. In the ArchiveMaster interface, easily manage your past orders by archiving old orders for better organization or exporting them as a file for backup.

Learn more about how Archive Master works through our overview video.
sections.faq:
Do I need to know any programming language for using this plugin?

No coding knowledge is required for using this plugin.

How do I archive my old orders data from my store database?

The easiest way to archive old orders data from your store database is through the Archive Master plugin. Install and activate the plugin and reduce load from your store.

Why is my WooCommerce store slow, and can archiving help?

Hosting, themes, and plugins can all slow a store down. A large orders table is another common cause, because WooCommerce keeps processing old records. Archiving old orders moves them out of your active database, which can help speed up WooCommerce, especially the admin and Orders page. Results depend on your hosting, database, and order volume.

What happens to customer order history on their account page?

Nothing changes for your customers unless you want it to. You can easily toggle settings to let customers view their archived WooCommerce order history directly from their My Account page, keeping their experience completely seamless.

Will archiving old orders affect my WooCommerce sales analytics?

No. ArchiveMaster integrates directly with WooCommerce Analytics, allowing you to include archived data in your reporting whenever needed for complete and accurate revenue tracking.

Will archiving orders break active WooCommerce Subscriptions or recurring renewals?

No. ArchiveMaster automatically detects active subscription plugins (like WooCommerce Subscriptions) and skips active orders. Your recurring billing and automatic renewals will keep running smoothly.

How do I export WooCommerce orders?

Open the ArchiveMaster download option, choose all or selected orders, and pick CSV, JSON, or XML. To export archived orders, go to Archived Orders and click “Export Orders” (JSON and XML in Free, CSV in Pro).

Can I delete my Activity Logs in bulk?

Yes. You can delete individual entries, or a full page of logs at a time, in the free version. With Pro, the Delete All option clears every log entry at once, with a progress indicator and a Stop button if you change your mind.

Where do I contact for support?

Please use the official WordPress support forum to report your issues.

Can developers add their own archive ranges?

Yes. Use the archm_archive_ranges filter to register a range key with a relative date modifier, for example add_filter( 'archm_archive_ranges', function ( $ranges ) { $ranges['2_months'] = '-2 months'; return $ranges; } );. For ranges that resolve to a fixed date, register the key with an empty modifier and return the date (Y-m-d) from the archm_archive_cutoff_date filter, which receives the computed cutoff, the range key and an optional explicit date.

Privacy Policy

Archive Master uses Appsero SDK to collect some telemetry data upon user’s confirmation. This helps us to troubleshoot problems faster & make product improvements.

Appsero SDK is included to track opt-in usage data and process deactivation feedback. See the “External services” section above for details on what is sent and when. No marketing or newsletter subscription is performed.

Integrating Appsero SDK DOES NOT IMMEDIATELY start gathering data, without confirmation from users in any case.

Learn more about how Appsero collects and uses this data.

External services

Amazon RDS / Remote MySQL

When an administrator supplies database credentials in Settings, ArchiveMaster connects to the specified MySQL server to store archived orders. No data is sent until credentials are saved. No third-party service is involved; the connection goes directly to the server you configure.

Appsero — Usage Tracking

After explicit opt-in consent, the Appsero SDK sends site environment details (PHP/MySQL/WP versions, active plugin count, admin email, site URL) to api.appsero.com once per week. Declining tracking sends zero data. You can revoke consent at any time.
Service: Appsero
Terms of Service: https://appsero.com/terms-conditions/
Privacy Policy: https://appsero.com/privacy-policy/

Appsero — Deactivation Feedback

When you deactivate the plugin and submit the optional feedback form, the site URL, plugin version, and your selected reason are sent to api.appsero.com. Skipping the form sends no data.
Service: Appsero
Terms of Service: https://appsero.com/terms-conditions/
Privacy Policy: https://appsero.com/privacy-policy/

Appsero — IP Address Lookup

When usage tracking is active, the Appsero SDK retrieves the server’s public IP address from icanhazip.com (operated by Cloudflare). Only the server IP is sent; no user-identifiable data is transmitted.
Service: icanhazip.com
Privacy Policy: https://www.cloudflare.com/privacypolicy/

YouTube — Help Videos

Settings pages embed help videos from youtube-nocookie.com (privacy-enhanced mode). No request is made until the user clicks Play. Data is handled by Google/YouTube.
Service: YouTube
Terms of Service: https://www.youtube.com/t/terms
Privacy Policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy

Google Drive — Cloud Backup (Pro add-on)

When the Pro add-on is active and the administrator authorizes Google Drive, OAuth tokens are exchanged via auth.archivemaster.pro. Archived database files are uploaded to Google Drive. No data is sent without explicit authorization.
Service: Google Drive API
Terms of Service: https://developers.google.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy

ArchiveMaster Auth Proxy — Google Drive OAuth (Pro add-on)

OAuth authentication for Google Drive is routed through auth.archivemaster.pro, which acts as a proxy to exchange authorization codes for access tokens. Only OAuth tokens and the administrator email are transmitted during the authorization flow. No data is stored on the proxy beyond token exchange.
Service: auth.archivemaster.pro
Terms of Service: https://archivemaster.pro/terms-of-service/
Privacy Policy: https://archivemaster.pro/privacy-policy/

WPPOOL — Cross-Promotion Links

Admin-only promotional banners may contain links through go.wppool.dev and lnk.wppool.dev redirect domains. These are standard URL redirects triggered only by administrator clicks. No data is collected automatically.
Service: WPPOOL
Terms of Service: https://developer.wppool.dev/terms-and-conditions/
Privacy Policy: https://developer.wppool.dev/privacy-policy/

Gravatar — Activity Log Avatars

The Activity Logs page displays user profile pictures via WordPress get_avatar_url(), which generates URLs pointing to gravatar.com. The browser requests these images directly from Gravatar, transmitting a hash of the user email address. No additional data is sent by the plugin.
Service: Gravatar
Terms of Service: https://automattic.com/tos/
Privacy Policy: https://automattic.com/privacy/

Privacy

ArchiveMaster stores archived order data in the storage selected by the administrator. It does not send usage data without consent. Administrators can decline or revoke Appsero tracking. Database credentials are stored encrypted where supported and passwords are never exposed to browser scripts.

Build Instructions

Install Node.js and Composer, run npm ci followed by npm run build, then run composer install --no-dev --optimize-autoloader. The distributable plugin includes src, package configuration, compiled build assets, and the optimized Composer autoloader.

Third-party library: assets/js/sizzle.min.js is a WPPOOL toast / notification helper (named after its selector engine, not the Sizzle CSS selector library bundled with jQuery). It is enqueued only on this plugin’s screens.
